raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

An EAGLE draft extend writes `num_tokens_per_req` rows per request, the accepted ones first, and each row attends over its own sliding window. Planned eagerly, FlashInfer's window wrapper starts its read a window before the first of those rows. Replayed from a CUDA graph, the draft extend plans without prefix lengths, and `update_sliding_window` derived them as `seq_lens - num_accept_tokens`, as if only the accepted rows were queries. The read then started up to `num_tokens_per_req - num_accept_tokens` tokens too late: once a sequence is longer than the window plus the accepted tokens, accepted row j lost up to `num_tokens_per_req - num_accept_tokens - j` of the earliest keys in its window.

This hits a draft with sliding-window layers (for example an EAGLE3 draft run with `--speculative-draft-window-size`) on FlashInfer with draft-extend CUDA graphs on, on any KV pool. The draft's proposals change; the target still verifies every token.

This PR used to carry wider FlashInfer and TRTLLM MHA window support and backend allow-list changes. Upstream's unified-memory rewrite absorbed those, and this one replay fix is what remains.

## Modifications

A draft-extend input now plans the window from `seq_lens - num_tokens_per_req`, the read its eager plan makes (`layers/attention/flashinfer_backend.py`).

Tests:
- CPU, `test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_flashinfer_draft_extend_window.py`: a graph replay and an eager plan of the same draft extend read the same window for every row (lengths [12, 5, 12] for a window of 8 and four rows per request); on main the replay reads [9, 5, 10].
- CUDA (SM90), `test/registered/attention/unittests/dense/test_draft_window_attention.py`, with a runner in `python/sglang/test/kits/attention_unittest/runner_modes/speculative_draft_window_runner.py`: the eager draft extend against an independent window reference for every row of the block, then the captured replay against the eager outputs, with fewer tokens accepted than queried. It fails on main and passes with this PR.

## Accuracy Tests

The tests above decide correctness. The model runs show no measurable change.

SM90, `NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` with `lmsys/sglang-EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B`, `--speculative-algorithm EAGLE3 --speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4 --speculative-draft-window-size 64`, FlashInfer, default pool, radix cache. sgl-eval GSM8K, all 1314 test questions, `--temperature 0 --max-tokens 1024`; median accept length from the scheduler logs.

| build | GSM8K (graphs off / on) | accept length (graphs off / on) |
|---|---|---|
| main `76d5b3ce02` | 0.8280 / 0.8272 | 2.14 / 2.15 |
| this PR on `76d5b3ce02` | 0.8288 / 0.8219 | 2.13 / 2.15 |
| this PR with the other open unified-memory PRs, on `259f0131c9` | 0.8234 / 0.8234 | 2.14 / 2.14 |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not benchmarked: the change corrects one start offset and makes no throughput or latency claim.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).

@@ -2050,7 +2050,14 @@ def update_sliding_window(

             )
-        if prefix_lens is None:

@@ -0,0 +1,197 @@
+"""Check FlashInfer draft-extend attention against a window oracle, then replay it."""
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.logits_processor import LogitsProcessorOutput
+
+from ..attention_methods.dense_attention import (
+    DEFAULT_DEVICE,
+    DEFAULT_DTYPE,
+    DEFAULT_HEAD_DIM,
+    DEFAULT_HIDDEN_SIZE,
+    DEFAULT_MAX_CONTEXT_LEN,
+    DENSE_ATOL,
+    DENSE_RTOL,
+    DenseAttentionCase,
+    _dense_attention_reference,
+    build_dense_attention_fixture,
+)
+from .speculative_draft_extend_runner import (
+    EagleDraftExtendCudaGraphRunnerAdapter,
+    _build_eagle_draft_extend_fixture,
+    _capture_eagle_draft_extend_graph_runner,
+    _draft_extend_select_index,
+    _make_dense_draft_extend_inputs,
+    _make_dense_draft_extend_model_forward,
+    _make_dense_eagle_draft_extend_v2_forward_batch,
+    _prepare_dense_draft_extend_replay_state,
+    _run_eagle_draft_extend_eager,
+)
+from .speculative_draft_runner import (
+    EagleDraftRunnerSettings,
+    _reset_cuda_graph_test_buffers,
+)
+
+
+class _AttentionRecorder:
+    """Each call of an attention module: its input hidden states and output."""
+
+    def __init__(self, module):
+        self.calls = []
+        forward = module.forward
+
+        def recording_forward(hidden_states, forward_batch):
+            out = forward(hidden_states, forward_batch)
+            self.calls.append((hidden_states.detach().clone(), out.detach().clone()))
+            return out
+
+        module.forward = recording_forward
+
+
+def _settings(
+    *,
+    topk,
+    speculative_num_steps,
+    speculative_num_draft_tokens,
+    cuda_graph_capture_batch_size,
+    hidden_size,
+    vocab_size,
+    max_context_len,
+    dtype,
+    device,
+) -> EagleDraftRunnerSettings:
+    return EagleDraftRunnerSettings(
+        topk=topk,
+        speculative_num_steps=speculative_num_steps,
+        speculative_num_draft_tokens=speculative_num_draft_tokens,
+        capture_batch_size=cuda_graph_capture_batch_size,
+        hidden_size=hidden_size,
+        vocab_size=vocab_size,
+        max_context_len=max_context_len,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        device=device,
+        atol=DENSE_ATOL,
+        rtol=DENSE_RTOL,
+    )
+
+
+def run_dense_eagle_draft_extend_window_case(
+    testcase,
+    case: DenseAttentionCase,
+    *,
+    num_accept_tokens: tuple[int, ...],
+    cuda_graph_capture_batch_size: int = 4,
+    head_dim: int = DEFAULT_HEAD_DIM,
+    hidden_size: int = DEFAULT_HIDDEN_SIZE,
+    max_context_len: int = DEFAULT_MAX_CONTEXT_LEN,
+    vocab_size: int = 64,
+    dtype: torch.dtype = DEFAULT_DTYPE,
+    device: str = DEFAULT_DEVICE,
+):
+    """The eager draft extend against the window oracle (every row of the
+    constant-width block), then the captured draft extend's replay against
+    the eager outputs."""
+    if case.sliding_window_size is None or not case.forward_mode.is_draft_extend_v2():
+        raise ValueError(
+            "draft-extend window coverage expects DRAFT_EXTEND_V2 cases with a window"
+        )
+    if len(set(case.input_lens)) != 1:
+        raise ValueError("DRAFT_EXTEND_V2 runner coverage uses fixed token counts.")
+    num_tokens_per_req = case.input_lens[0]
+    if len(num_accept_tokens) != case.batch_size or any(
+        n < 1 or n > num_tokens_per_req for n in num_accept_tokens
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Acceptance counts must fit each request's fixed-width block.")
+    settings = _settings(
+        topk=1,
+        speculative_num_steps=num_tokens_per_req - 1,
+        speculative_num_draft_tokens=num_tokens_per_req,
+        cuda_graph_capture_batch_size=cuda_graph_capture_batch_size,
+        hidden_size=hidden_size,
+        vocab_size=vocab_size,
+        max_context_len=max_context_len,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        device=device,
+    )
+    if case.batch_size > settings.capture_batch_size:
+        raise ValueError("Capture batch size must cover the replay batch size.")
+
+    def make_forward_batch(fixture, case, draft_inputs, settings):
+        batch = _make_dense_eagle_draft_extend_v2_forward_batch(
+            fixture, case, draft_inputs, settings
+        )
+        # The forward still queries the whole block when verification accepted
+        # fewer tokens. Full acceptance would hide the replay's short-window bug.
+        accepted = torch.tensor(num_accept_tokens, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        batch.spec_info.num_accept_tokens = accepted
+        batch.spec_info.num_accept_tokens_cpu = list(num_accept_tokens)
+        batch.spec_info.num_correct_drafts = accepted - 1
+        return batch
+
+    adapter = EagleDraftExtendCudaGraphRunnerAdapter(
+        build_fixture=build_dense_attention_fixture,
+        make_model_forward=_make_dense_draft_extend_model_forward,
+        make_draft_inputs=_make_dense_draft_extend_inputs,
+        prepare_replay_state=_prepare_dense_draft_extend_replay_state,
+        make_forward_batch=make_forward_batch,
+    )
+    # The replay state writes the prefix's K/V at contiguous slots; a shuffled
+    # prefix would read over the slots those writes land in.
+    build_kwargs = dict(
+        head_dim=head_dim,
+        hidden_size=hidden_size,
+        max_context_len=max_context_len,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        device=device,
+        loc_layout="contiguous",
+    )
+    try:
+        draft_inputs = adapter.make_draft_inputs(case, settings)
+
+        fixture, worker, _ = _build_eagle_draft_extend_fixture(
+            testcase,
+            case,
+            adapter=adapter,
+            build_kwargs=build_kwargs,
+            settings=settings,
+        )
+        recorder = _AttentionRecorder(fixture.actual_module)
+        adapter.prepare_replay_state(fixture, case, draft_inputs, settings)
+        batch = adapter.make_forward_batch(fixture, case, draft_inputs, settings)
+        eager = _run_eagle_draft_extend_eager(worker, batch, settings)
+        ((hidden, out),) = recorder.calls
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            out,
+            _dense_attention_reference(
+                fixture.reference_module, case, fixture.prefix_hidden, hidden
+            ),
+            atol=settings.atol,
+            rtol=settings.rtol,
+        )
+        select_index = _draft_extend_select_index(batch, settings)
+        expected = LogitsProcessorOutput(
+            next_token_logits=eager.next_token_logits[select_index],
+            hidden_states=eager.hidden_states[select_index],
+        )
+
+        graph_fixture, graph_worker, graph_backend = _build_eagle_draft_extend_fixture(
+            testcase,
+            case,
+            adapter=adapter,
+            build_kwargs=build_kwargs,
+            settings=settings,
+        )
+        adapter.prepare_replay_state(graph_fixture, case, draft_inputs, settings)
+        graph_batch = adapter.make_forward_batch(
+            graph_fixture, case, draft_inputs, settings
+        )
+        graph_runner = _capture_eagle_draft_extend_graph_runner(
+            graph_worker, graph_backend, settings
+        )
+        adapter.prepare_replay_state(graph_fixture, case, draft_inputs, settings)
+        testcase.assertTrue(graph_runner.can_run_graph(graph_batch))
+        adapter.assert_outputs_close(
+            graph_runner.execute(graph_batch, select_index), expected, settings
+        )
+    finally:
+        _reset_cuda_graph_test_buffers()

@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+"""Regression: replay must read the same complete window as eager draft extend."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_mode import ForwardMode
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.kits.attention_unittest.attention_methods.dense_attention import (
+    DenseAttentionCase,
+)
+from sglang.test.kits.attention_unittest.runner_modes.speculative_draft_window_runner import (
+    run_dense_eagle_draft_extend_window_case,
+)
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=40, stage="base-b", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available(), "CUDA required")
+class TestFlashInferDraftWindowAttention(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_draft_extend_rows_read_their_window(self):
+        case = DenseAttentionCase(
+            name="draft_extend_window_flashinfer",
+            backend="flashinfer",
+            forward_mode=ForwardMode.DRAFT_EXTEND_V2,
+            num_heads=4,
+            num_kv_heads=2,
+            page_size=16,
+            prefix_lens=(2, 9, 20),
+            extend_lens=(4, 4, 4),
+            sliding_window_size=8,
+        )
+        run_dense_eagle_draft_extend_window_case(
+            self, case, num_accept_tokens=(4, 1, 2), head_dim=64, hidden_size=256
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

@@ -0,0 +1,73 @@
+"""BUG REGRESSION: a FlashInfer draft extend replayed from a CUDA graph must
+read each row's whole sliding window, as the same draft extend planned eagerly
+does."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention import flashinfer_backend as fb
+from sglang.srt.speculative.eagle_info import EagleDraftExtendInput
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+WINDOW = 8
+NUM_TOKENS_PER_REQ = 4
+
+
+def _planned_window(*, seq_lens, prefix_lens, spec_info):
+    """(lengths, start offsets) the window wrapper is planned with."""
+    updater = object.__new__(fb.FlashInferIndicesUpdaterPrefill)
+    updater.sliding_window_size = WINDOW
+    updater.prefill_wrapper_ragged = None
+    updater._swa_kv_pool = None
+    updater.kv_indptr = [torch.zeros(4, dtype=torch.int32) for _ in range(2)]
+    updater.qo_indptr = [torch.zeros(4, dtype=torch.int32) for _ in range(2)]
+    planned = []
+    updater.call_begin_forward = lambda *args, **kwargs: planned.append(args)
+    updater.update_sliding_window(
+        torch.arange(seq_lens.numel()),
+        seq_lens,
+        seq_lens.clone(),
+        int(seq_lens.sum()),
+        prefix_lens,
+        [None, None],
+        False,
+        None,
+        spec_info,
+        plan=None,
+    )
+    window_args = planned[0]
+    # call_begin_forward(..., paged_kernel_lens, ..., kv_start_idx, ...)
+    return window_args[3], window_args[7]
+
+
+class TestFlashInferDraftExtendWindow(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_a_graph_replay_reads_the_window_of_every_row(self):
+        # Lengths after the draft extend wrote its NUM_TOKENS_PER_REQ rows, the
+        # accepted ones first; a graph replay plans without prefix lengths.
+        seq_lens = torch.tensor([30, 5, 12])
+        num_accept_tokens = torch.tensor([1, 4, 2])
+        spec_info = EagleDraftExtendInput(
+            num_correct_drafts=num_accept_tokens - 1,
+            num_accept_tokens=num_accept_tokens,
+            num_tokens_per_req=NUM_TOKENS_PER_REQ,
+        )
+        replay = _planned_window(
+            seq_lens=seq_lens, prefix_lens=None, spec_info=spec_info
+        )
+        eager = _planned_window(
+            seq_lens=seq_lens,
+            prefix_lens=seq_lens - NUM_TOKENS_PER_REQ,
+            spec_info=None,
+        )
+        lens = torch.clamp(seq_lens, max=WINDOW + NUM_TOKENS_PER_REQ)
+        for planned in (replay, eager):
+            torch.testing.assert_close(planned[0], lens, rtol=0, atol=0)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(planned[1], seq_lens - lens, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
